digest.component_or_area: CLI verb routing and consumer migration
propositions: Three legacy top-level CLI verbs must be renamed and re-nested under a bridge noun: bridge-fsck→bridge fsck, bridge-probe→bridge check-access, jira-onboard→bridge setup

All in-tree consumers (CLI dispatch arms, help text, scripts, tests, docs, workflows) must be migrated to the new canonical spellings while preserving the old spellings as functional compatibility entrypoints
The bridge setup command must retain pass-through delegation to the existing jira-onboard wizard with preserved argument ownership and both invocation paths must support identical help and options

Each renamed command must behave identically to its legacy spelling with no behavioral forking: fsck audits records, check-access creates/deletes a Jira issue for access validation, setup persists config then validates via check-access
Legacy top-level bridge-fsck and bridge-probe aliases and top-level jira-onboard intercept must remain executable and route through identical implementation paths to prevent workflow breakage
